statistical_unit: Independently launched process means, paired by distinct cohort/block ID.
interval: Nominal pointwise paired two-sided Student t95; no sequential-selection or multiplicity adjustment.
selection_note: One extra four-block cohort for Root, NoListeners, Dropped, AmbientParent, and SuppliedContext was selected after between-process variation was observed, not by direction/significance; the base plan was frozen.
